items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 16:1
items.html: The reflected light that ascends by force of the coupling upon the coarseness in the screen is called Hevel [vapor]. For the five levels of reflected light that ascend from the five phases in the screen divide into three discernments: those of phase four, phase three, and phase two are called Hevel; the level of reflected light that ascends from phase one is called a fine look; and the reflected light that ascends from the coarseness of Keter is called “the revelation of illumination.” (p. 604, Item 7)
